final_message:
Generated the DNS configuration with **13 authoritative zones and 12 delegations** on pc1–pc13, the recursive resolver on pc14, and clients pc16–pc20 pointing to it. The requested service and MX records are included.

Created BIND configuration and zone files under the assigned PCs’ `etc/bind` directories and appended DNS startup commands. The existing `kathara/base` images were retained; topology, IP addresses and routes were preserved.

I assumed `www.example.com` points to pc4 (`10.14.1.14`), because no separate web host was specified. Static checks passed for the zone and delegation counts, client configuration and MX records. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, so syntax and live resolution remain to be verified externally.
